title: Strict hot spots and absence of critical points for smooth planar Neumann ground modes
exact_target: For every bounded smooth simply connected planar domain and every nonzero first-positive Neumann Laplacian eigenfunction, including every vector in a multiple first eigenspace, is its gradient nonzero at every interior point and is every interior value strictly between its boundary minimum and maximum?
